subject: POC trial planning - RACI & stakeholder mapping for Clearwater Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@clearwaterhealth.org>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@clearwaterhealth.org>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & next steps — Clearwater POC (success criteria + RACI)

Samantha / Michael — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of call:
- Goals: validate streaming response latency at 99th pct under typical clinical throughput, verify embedding quality for chart search, and confirm secure handling of PHI in-transit and at-rest.
- Success criteria (proposed):
  1) Average token latency < 120ms, 99th < 350ms for 8k context under test workload.
  2) Embedding recall > 0.82 on your seed eval set (we'll run the eval with your sample queries).
  3) No PHI leaves your VPC; KMS-managed keys for model infra; audit logs accessible for 90 days.

POC timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (align): sign mutual NDA / minimal contract (procurement) + sandbox access.
- Week 1-2: infra provisioning, VPC peering, KMS setup, network tests.
- Week 3: run initial integration tests + baseline evals.
- Week 4: performance run & review, finalize go/no-go decision.

Ownership (initial RACI draft — attached):
- Infra (network, VPC peering, keys): Clearwater owner; Redwood infra lead = Aditya Rao (tech contact, will provision dedicated instance).
- App integration (API calls, embedding ingestion): Clearwater app owner (Samantha) with Redwood PM = Lauren Bishop.
- Security/compliance review: Clearwater security (Lisa Chen) with Redwood security lead = Rishi Malhotra.
- Procurement / contracts: Clearwater procurement (Michael Torres) with Redwood sales ops = Laura Bennett.

Attachments: clearwater-poc-raci.xlsx (RACI + contact matrix), clearwater-network-diagram.png, rdw-poc-sla-draft.pdf.

Ask: Please confirm owners above and availability for a short kickoff this Thurs or Fri (30 minutes) so we can lock Week 0 items. Also confirm any procurement timelines or PO requirements.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
---

From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@clearwaterhealth.org>

Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps — Clearwater POC (success criteria + RACI)

Thanks Marissa — that summary is great and aligns with our internal notes. Quick clarifications / additions: 

- Confirmed owners: Michael will handle procurement, Lisa will lead security review, and I will own app integration. I'll introduce you to our infra lead (cc'd: matt.olson@clearwaterhealth.org) but note Matt may not be on all threads until we hit provisioning. For now please keep technical ask details to Aditya (as you suggested).
- Procurement timeline: we typically need a signed SOW + PO; Michael expects 7-10 business days once SOW is approved. He asked whether Redwood can accept a standard PO and if we have any specific insurance/SLAs we should highlight.
- Security asks: Lisa flagged that they will need a SOC2 attestation and KMS/HSM details; she also requested a short list of data flow diagrams and any required agent footprints.

We can do a 30-min kickoff on Friday 07/10 at 10:00am PT. Does that work for the Redwood team?

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Green
Director, Product Integrations | Clearwater Health

Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Clearwater POC — please confirm assignments (RACI)

Team — looped in after the customer confirmed owners and the kickoff slot. Action items I need from each of you ahead of Friday: 

Aditya — can you confirm estimated lead time to provision a dedicated instance + VPC peering and whether we can support KMS-managed keys for their tenant? Please call out any network firewall rules or IP allowlist requirements. If 10 business days is required, flag and we'll push timeline.

Lauren — you'll be the PM for the engagement. Please prepare a 1-page kickoff agenda and own the integration test plan (embedding ingestion tasks + eval set ingestion).

Rishi — customer requested SOC2 attestation + data flow diagram. Can you prepare a short summary and the list of artefacts they will need? Also confirm whether our standard audit log retention (90 days) is OK or whether we need to propose an add-on.

Laura — procurement/ops: can you prepare a SOW template + insurance certs bundle we can share with Michael? Also confirm whether we can accept a PO and any billing lead times.

I'll host the kickoff on Friday and share calendar invite once folks confirm.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps — Clearwater POC (infra readiness)

Marissa / Samantha — thanks. Quick infra update and constraints so procurement and security can plan: 

- Provisioning: We can provide a single-tenant dedicated instance in Redwood Dedicated or a private VPC package for Clearwater. Estimated provisioning lead time: 8-10 business days after network sign-off and KMS access is provided.
- Networking: We'll need VPC peering (or VPN) + a small set of IPs for allowlist. I'll attach the network diagram and a checklist.
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed KMS keys; we'll need an IAM contact and key ARN for setup.
- Data handling: For PHI workflows, recommend disabled outbound telemetry and enable strict audit logging. We can ship logs to your SIEM via S3 or direct syslog - let security pick preference.

Attachments: clearwater-network-diagram.png and a short "infra-checklist.md" (summary).

I'll be on the kickoff on Fri 07/10 to walk the provisioning steps. If procurement needs proof of SOC2, Rishi can share the attestation.

Aditya Rao
Staff Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference

See you on Friday.

Best,
Samantha
